Setup, once: (1) on console.cloud.google.com create a project (free) and turn on the Google Classroom API (APIs & Services > Library); (2) under OAuth consent screen choose External, add your school address as a test user, then press Publish app so the sign-in does not expire after 7 days; (3) under Credentials create an OAuth client ID of type Desktop app; (4) paste its client ID and secret here, press Connect and sign in with your school account.

Schools decide which apps may read their Google accounts, and many do not allow it for students. If yours does not, Google says so on the sign-in page (and may offer to ask the school's IT). That is the school's choice; homework you tell Jarvis keeps working either way.
